subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The great director Satyajit Ray after receiving the Honorary Academic Award from Audrey Hepburn, ________ in his Kolkata home.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1), i.e., 'breathed his last.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the phrases given in the options:

 
 
 

 Phrase
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 breathed his last
 to die. (मर जाना)
 
 

 nipped in the bud
 to stop something at an early stage. (प्रारंभिक अवस्था में किसी चीज़ को रोकना)
 
 

 kept the ball rolling 
 to keep something going. (कुछ जारी रखना)
 
 

 dug the grave
 to create a difficult situation for oneself. (अपने लिए एक कठिन स्थिति पैदा करना)
 
 
 
 

 
• The context of the sentence is that the great director Satyajit Ray received the Honorary Academic Award from Audrey Hepburn. After that, **he died** in his Kolkata home.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "breathed his last."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

 
• Another example:

 
 
• *The sick man **breathed his last** at ten o'clock this morning.*
 
 

 

Complete Sentence:__ *The great director Satyajit Ray after receiving the Honorary Academic Award from Audrey Hepburn, __breathed his last__ in his Kolkata home.*
